# wso2is_push_sender (Resource)

Manages a push notification provider. In the Console, this is **Notification Channels > Push Providers**. The push notification authenticator uses it. WSO2 IS 7.3 supports Firebase Cloud Messaging and Amazon SNS, with one of each per tenant. The server returns the credentials in its API responses, so the credentials appear in the Terraform state. To import, use the ID `FCM_PushPublisher` or `AmazonSNS_PushPublisher`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Firebase Cloud Messaging, as the default provider.
resource "wso2is_push_sender" "fcm" {
  provider_name = "FCM"
  default       = true
  fcm = {
    service_account_json = var.firebase_service_account_json # file("service-account.json")
  }
}

# Amazon SNS, for devices that register with it.
resource "wso2is_push_sender" "sns" {
  provider_name = "AmazonSNS"
  amazon_sns = {
    access_key_id     = var.aws_access_key_id
    secret_access_key = var.aws_secret_access_key
    region            = "eu-west-1"
    platform_arns = {
      FCM  = "arn:aws:sns:eu-west-1:123456789012:app/GCM/acme-authenticator"
      APNS = "arn:aws:sns:eu-west-1:123456789012:app/APNS/acme-authenticator"
    }
  }
}

variable "firebase_service_account_json" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "aws_access_key_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "aws_secret_access_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_name` (String) `FCM` or `AmazonSNS`. Changing it replaces the sender.

### Optional

- `amazon_sns` (Attributes) Amazon SNS settings (with `provider_name = "AmazonSNS"`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--amazon_sns))
- `default` (Boolean) Use this provider for devices that do not name one when they register. The default is `false`.
- `fcm` (Attributes) Firebase Cloud Messaging settings (with `provider_name = "FCM"`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fcm))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Sender name: `<provider_name>_PushPublisher`.

<a id="nestedatt--amazon_sns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `amazon_sns`

Required:

- `access_key_id` (String) Access key ID of an IAM user allowed to manage SNS platform endpoints and publish.
- `platform_arns` (Map of String) Platform application ARN by platform, for example `{ FCM = "arn:aws:sns:...:app/GCM/my-app", APNS = "..." }`.
- `region` (String) AWS region, for example `eu-west-1`.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret access key.


<a id="nestedatt--fcm"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fcm`

Required:

- `service_account_json` (String, Sensitive) Content of the Firebase service account key file (JSON), for example `file("service-account.json")`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_push_sender.fcm FCM_PushPublisher
```
